title: The Fifty Nairobi Women Who Would Not Let Ingrid Munro Retire
conflicts: Membership: about 170,000 in 2007 (SvD 2007, IMD) vs about or over 200,000 by 2009 (Dagen, SvD 2009), 250,000 (Grameen America blog, not cited), peak over 300,000 (IMD); story uses the 2007 figure. Employer named African Housing Fund (SvD 2007, The Standard) or Foundation (SvD 2009); story uses Fund. IMD wrongly dates the founding to 2010; The Standard gives 22 November 1999. How she knew the women: slum housing project (SvD 2009) and mothers of her sons' friends (IMD); both given.
notes: Founding episode rests on two Svenska Dagbladet interviews in Swedish; all speech is reported and translated, no direct quotation marks. Kept strictly to 1999 to 2007 per the editor's note; Jamii Bora Bank's later troubles are not told. The 8,000/16,000 shilling first round appears only in SvD 2007. Repeat screen flagged three unrelated same-founder false positives and let it through.
